channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anthony Mason | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anthony Mason from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Patrick Ewing, Anthony Mason
item.description:
Oakley felt he never received the same ‘Once a Knick, Always a Knick’ treatment of some of his former teammates, including team employees John Starks and Allan Houston.

“Me, Anthony Mason, and Patrick Ewing were always on the outside — they never offered us anything (job-wise) worth taking,”

Charles Oakley on Patrick Ewing, Anthony Mason, Feb 3, 2022. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Chuck Hayes on Anthony Mason
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Chuck Hayes on Anthony Mason:

“Fair to say that early in my career I studied his game to make a niche for myself to stay in the league.”

Chuck Hayes on Anthony Mason, Feb 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Anthony Mason
item.description:
Jordan:

“I’m deeply saddened to learn about the passing of Anthony Mason. Mase was one of the toughest competitors of his era. While on the Hornets, he was beloved by fans throughout the Carolinas for his hard-nosed play and skill on the court. The Hornets organization extends its condolences to his entire family.”

Michael Jordan on Anthony Mason, Feb 28, 2015. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Pat Riley on Anthony Mason
item.description:
Joseph Goodman:Pat Riley on Anthony Mason:

“To lose him so quickly during his journey, especially to those of us that knew him, hurts.”

Pat Riley on Anthony Mason, Feb 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @JoeGoodmanJr.

item.title: Don Cronson on Anthony Mason
item.description:
“(Mason) was in the hospital. I think he was having some discomfort, some kind of chest pain. One of his guys said, ‘You have to have yourself looked at.’ He goes into the hospital and the whole event took place there. I spoke to family members, and had he been in the (hospital) lobby as opposed to the third floor, where he was, he would have died. Fortunately, he was close enough to the emergency facilities that were brought to bear and saved his life.”

Don Cronson on Anthony Mason, Feb 14, 2015. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Ricky Davis on Anthony Mason, Eddie Jones, Derrick Coleman
item.description:
“You know why? I came in with Anthony Mason, Derrick Coleman, Eddie Jones. [They would tell rookies] 'You put the bags up. You better have the condoms. You better meet us.' That's what I came into.”

Ricky Davis on Anthony Mason, Eddie Jones, Derrick Coleman, Apr 12, 2013. Source: Grantland.
